title: Core banking legacy migration and reconciliation protocol
workflow: Acquire lawfully permitted source snapshot and lineage inventory
Define deterministic IDs, encoding, date, product and accounting crosswalks
Validate schema, identity links and effective rule versions in dry run
Compare source-to-target record counts and exact monetary control totals
Quarantine unmatched/ambiguous accounts and obtain independent remediation
Cut over only after authorized trial balance and operational sign-off
invariants: No guessed 312/322 PCEC mapping in conversion
Never overwrite historical posting to make totals balance
Record original source bytes/hashes when actually obtained
A duplicate migration attempt must not double-credit accounts
Source/target disagreement fails the affected cutover
Customer identity and legal mandates retain provenance
Cutover time and reversible technical operations are separately recorded
acceptance_tests: Duplicate source row cannot create duplicate funds
Debit/credit totals exact within approved currency model
Restored rehearsal preserves source-to-target audit references
independent_gate: Authentic source data access, reviewed PCEC mapping, CFO/accounting acceptance and executed dry-run reconciliation.
